issues.explanation: Chapter 24 says Liu Bei’s wives were captured by Cao’s army when Xiaopei fell, then immediately says Cao Cao planned to take Xiapi and seize the family protected by Guan Yu. In the source, the family remains in Xiapi under Guan Yu’s protection; they are not captured at Xiaopei. This also conflicts with Chapter 25, where Guan Yu is still defending them in Xiapi.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the capture statement with: “小沛失守后，刘备的家眷仍在下邳，由关羽保护。”
